main_text.p: eo loco sese lavarent: verum illac in balneum descenderent, ut etiam habes sub hujus capitis finem; deinde ibidem focus, quo à balneo redeuntes se calefacerent abstergerentque, extrueretur. Unde codice תמיד cap. 3. dicitur [illegible, ~10 letters] locus incendiarus vel ardoris, ab ardente illic igni: ideoque differentiæ causa structura illa major, cui hoc conclave substructionis instar adjacebat, etiam locus ardoris major vocari assolet. Confirmabo paucis Bartenoræ verbis, [illegible, ~12 letters] [illegible, ~20 letters] id est, Ibi erat focus ad quem se Sacerdos postquam corpus abluisset calefaceret, atque à balneo ascendens sese abstergeret: ardorisque conclave nuncupabatur, & versus locum ardoris majorem (ut loquuntur) aperiebatur.
main_text.head: SECT. 7.
main_text.p: שנים שעריםם היו לביתּ המוקד אחר פחוח לחיל ואחר פחוי לעזרה אמ׳ רבי יהודי זה שהיה פתוח לעזרה פשפש קטן היה לו שבו נכנסין לבלוש את העזרה

{1}Duæ erant portæ domui (quam vocant) incendij sive loco focario: una aperta versus spatium intermurale; altera quæ atrium respiciebat: ita dixit Rabbi Iehuda. Huic quæ versus atrium aperiebatur. {2}ostiolum erat parvum, per quod, ut atrium lustrarent, ingrediebantur.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: {1} Repetendum hic è superioribus, (quia à plurimis neglectum fuit) spatium quod inter murum totius structuræ extremum & atrij magni murum intercurrebat, circumcirca in duas partes divisum fuisse: quarum ea quæ muro atrij proximè adhærebat, חיל[?] dicebatur (quamvis hoc nomine quidam sepimentum intelligant, quod istam spatij partem undiquaque cingebat). Itaque duæ cum essent in hoc incendij (uti vocabant) loco portæ, harum una חיל[?], id est, intermurale spatium; altera atrium

page.notes: The Hebrew inline line after "Confirmabo paucis Bartenorae verbis" is printed in small type and I could not read it letter by letter; marked illegible. The Hebrew after "dicitur" is uncertain. The Hebrew word in the annotations (the term for the intermural space) is uncertain at both occurrences and marked [?]. The verse column is printed in Hebrew with a number "I." above it. Superscript note marks 1 and 2 in the Sect. 7 column are marked in braces. The "atrium" at the lower right is a catchword, so the text ends at "altera". The right page strip shows only cropped word fragments of its margin and is not transcribed.
